name: lvid.ret/moment/charades_sta
criteria_source: Written; gold is the quarter that holds every interval of the query; the query is quoted verbatim
notes: 114 Charades-STA test events, one per video, 29 / 28 / 29 / 28 per quarter, the correct option equally often in each position; every annotated window of the event lies in the answer quarter of the whole video (decoded duration). OneJev-27B scores 43.0 % and Jev-Omni 37.7 % (chance 25 %). Media: the official Charades license allows local evaluation only, no redistribution. The queries, windows and gold quarters ship as a recipe; `jevarena-mm build` fills them in from the Charades-STA test annotations, fetched with the videos. Leaf score: the mean of its sources, so these 114 items weigh as much as Ego4D-NLQ's 247 and QVHighlights's 139.

name: lvid.ret/moment/ego4d_nlq
source: Ego4D natural language queries, validation split (Grauman et al., 2022)
criteria_source: Written; gold is the quarter that holds all annotated response windows; the query is quoted verbatim
notes: 247 NLQ validation queries from 247 parent videos, 62 / 62 / 62 / 61 per quarter, the correct option equally often in each position; every annotation of the query lies in the answer quarter of the official clip, and the selection is spread over query templates and clip lengths. OneJev-27B scores 51.4 % and Jev-Omni 29.6 % (chance 25 %). The queries and gold quarters ship as a recipe; `jevarena-mm build` fills them in from your copy of the Ego4D annotations (Ego4D license; fetched with the videos). Leaf score: the mean of its sources, so these 247 items weigh as much as Charades-STA's 114 and QVHighlights's 139.
